decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The single storey front extension due to its size, position, and design, would not be harmful to the appearance of the building, Metropolitan Green Belt Land, or neighbouring residents' living conditions.  The development is in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-B.1.8 (Access and Facilities for People with Disabilities) ENV- N.1.2 (Acceptable Development in the Green Belt) and C.2.1 (Educational Facilities) of the Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
(Reason.  To accord with the provisions of Section 92(1) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990)

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

(Reason.  In order to safeguard the visual amenity of the area and building

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

(Reason.  To ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission)
description: Erection of a single strorey front extension adjacent to main entrance of college building.
